note: READ-ONLY AUDIT — architecture normalization proposal only

frozen_architecture_inventory.note: All 6 plomberie pilots use this string

collision_issues.description: Plomberie uses 'FIXEO_FIXED_PRICE'; all other métiers use 'FIXED'. Semantically identical. Must normalize to one string.
CLIM-003/004 use FIXED_PER_AC_UNIT but unit field already says PER_AC_UNIT. The per-unit qualifier belongs in the pricing_unit field, not architecture. Architecture = FIXED.
Three different strings for 'minimum charge' across bricolage, nettoyage, peinture. All express the same anti-additive floor rule.
collision_issues.resolution: Canonical: MINIMUM_FLOOR with min_amount field; rule: FINAL_PRICE = max(min_amount, service_price)

collision_issues.description: Bricolage HOURLY (1 worker implicit) vs Nettoyage PER_CLEANER_HOUR (explicit worker count). These are DIFFERENT semantics and must NOT be collapsed.
collision_issues.resolution: Keep as distinct architectures: TIME_BASED_SINGLE (bricolage) vs TIME_BASED_TEAM (nettoyage)

collision_issues.description: HALF_DAY is a pre-packaged time block (400 MAD flat), not a continuous hourly rate. It is conceptually FIXED with a time-scope constraint, not TIME_BASED.
collision_issues.resolution: Canonical: FIXED (with duration scope metadata: 'up to 4h')

collision_issues.description: Bricolage and Nettoyage use different strings for per-item fixed pricing. Semantically equivalent.

All three are per-m² unit-rate services for peinture. The distinction is in materials_included, not architecture. Architecture for all = VARIABLE_UNIT; unit = PER_PAINTED_M2; materials field carries the distinction.
collision_issues.resolution: Canonical: VARIABLE_UNIT; unit: PER_PAINTED_M2; materials: {paint: CLIENT_SUPPLIED|INCLUDED, prep: EXCLUDED|INCLUDED}

collision_issues.description: Plafond uses ceiling m², not painted m². Must not be collapsed. The measurement_basis field carries this distinction, not the architecture.
collision_issues.resolution: Canonical: VARIABLE_UNIT; unit: PER_CEILING_M2. Do NOT merge with PER_PAINTED_M2.

collision_issues.description: ADD_ON is a distinct architecture: this service cannot be booked standalone; it adds to a primary service. No other métier has ADD_ON yet.
collision_issues.resolution: Canonical: ADD_ON — preserve as distinct architecture type

collision_issues.description: Both express 'unit rate with a minimum project value'. The pattern is identical: FINAL = max(minimum, unit_rate × m²).
collision_issues.resolution: Canonical: VARIABLE_UNIT with min_amount field; formula: MAX_OF_MINIMUM_OR_UNIT_MULTIPLICATION

FIXED.description: One canonical price. No inputs beyond service selection and eligibility check.
maps_from: FIXED_PER_AC_UNIT (with per-unit semantics moved to pricing_unit)

CONDITIONAL_FIXED.description: Fixed price contingent on eligibility conditions being met. If not met, escape to QUOTE.
CONDITIONAL_FIXED.formula: if eligibility_met: price = approved_fixed_price; else: QUOTE

VARIABLE_UNIT.description: Price = unit_rate × quantity. May have minimum floor. Quantity is user input.

TIME_BASED_SINGLE.description: Price = hourly_rate × hours. 1 worker implicit. Minimum billing period applies.

TIME_BASED_TEAM.description: Price = rate_per_cleaner_per_hour × worker_count × hours. Worker count is explicit user input.
TIME_BASED_TEAM.note: MUST NOT be collapsed with TIME_BASED_SINGLE — worker-count semantics differ fundamentally

LABOUR_FIXED_PART_SEPARATE.description: Fixed labour price. Hardware/part is separate, disclosed, and client-approved before purchase.
maps_from: FIXEO_FIXED_PRICE for robinet/chasse_eau (where client supplies part)

MINIMUM_FLOOR.description: Service price is always max(min_amount, calculated_price). Min is embedded, NOT additive.
MINIMUM_FLOOR.formula: price = max(min_amount, service_price). NEVER min_amount + service_price.

ADD_ON.description: Cannot be booked standalone. Always combined with a primary service of the same métier.
ADD_ON.formula: price = unit_rate × quantity (added to primary service price)

DIAGNOSTIC_FIRST.description: Artisan must diagnose before fixed price can be confirmed. Diagnostic fee charged; absorbed if standardized repair follows.
DIAGNOSTIC_FIRST.formula: diagnostic_fee charged; if standardized_repair: fee absorbed; else: fee + quote

QUOTE_REQUIRED.description: No standardized price possible. Quote from artisan required.
